title: Aquatic Center Luxury
summary:
We left the Grey's River on Saturday morning, which was probably a good call because it was starting to get overrun with big ATV groups out for the holiday week. In searching for a place to shower on iOverlander, we found out that Pinedale has a very nice aquatic center with a $10 day pass, so we decided to make that our first stop there. We spent a couple of hours working out, hot tubbing, playing in the lazy river, and showering before heading to a brewery for a snack and wifi. We decided to stay the night in Pinedale at a nice little campground on a lake so that we could do a day hike in the Wind River Range the next morning. The weather cooperated, and while it was chilly up in the mountains, we did a gorgeous little hike on the Sacred Rim Trail where we got beautiful views of the mountains.

-Helen
